name: Trustpilot Scraper
description: Trustpilot scraper for Python and the command line: public reviews of any company by its domain, with rating, title, text, dates, verification label, reviewer country and the company reply, plus TrustScore and review count, as JSON or CSV. Free and open source; sign in with your QuanticData account, no proxies or headless browser to run.

commands.name: reviews
commands.help: public Trustpilot reviews of a company
commands.description: Public Trustpilot reviews of any company — rating, text, dates, verification and the company reply.

inputs.name: domain
inputs.description: The reviewed company's domain, e.g. wise.com (not the Trustpilot URL).

inputs.name: stars
inputs.description: Only reviews with this star rating (1–5). Omit for all.

inputs.name: country
inputs.description: Country to run the request from, as an ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 code (us, gb, de...).

inputs.name: max_results
inputs.description: How many reviews to deliver at most (1–100). You pay only for delivered reviews.
